You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 小狗画梅花，小鸡画竹叶，小鸭画枫叶，小马画月牙。——打一样东西。

en.q: The puppy paints plum blossoms, the chick bamboo leaves, the duckling maple leaves, the pony crescent moons. What are they?
hints: The herb garden mud is full of them.

text.zh: 药园巡夜令。巡夜没好处，没人接。
text.en: The herb garden's night-watch token. Night watch has no perks, so nobody takes it.
Do you know your tracks?
You've got till the end of the month.

when.en: The twenty-second of the tenth month

facts.zh: 十月廿二一早，马小宝带着周衡踹开柴房，从小狰窝里翻出一株紫玉参，叶子还鲜，说是昨夜巡夜的偷的。阿禾扛着锄头来了：初八那一夜巡夜簿上写着两个名字，旁边一行又黑又粗的「马小宝 陪巡」是他自己写的；初九辰时石阶上丢着一只食盒，盒底一撮土，土里一片紫玉参的叶子，她压在本子里。她又给马小宝递了个台阶：「许是哪位师兄捡着了，替园子收着，送错了窝。」周衡说「送回来的，账上不记」，走了。阿禾初九就知道，一直没说：初九说是告状，今天说是对账——他自己把参送上门来，她才有账可对。放他下来，是因为拆穿了他下不来台，他下不来台，他表伯就要下来了。她冷着脸，一本正经，只对小满俏皮。
facts.en: Early on the twenty-second Ma Xiaobao kicks open the woodshed with Zhou Heng behind him and turns up a purple jade ginseng in the little zheng's nest, leaves still fresh: the night watchman stole it last night, he says. Ahe arrives with her hoe: the night-watch book's square for the eighth carries two names, and the thick black 'Ma Xiaobao, keeping him company' is in his own hand; on the ninth at the hour of the Dragon a food box lay on the steps, a pinch of earth in it, and in the earth a ginseng leaf, which she pressed in her notebook. Then she gave Ma Xiaobao a way down: 'perhaps some senior brother found it, kept it for the garden, and returned it to the wrong nest.' Zhou Heng says 'Brought back. Not entered in the accounts' and leaves. Ahe knew on the ninth and said nothing: on the ninth it would be telling tales, today it is checking the accounts — he brought the ginseng to the door himself. She let him down easy because shown up he can't climb down, and then his uncle would have to come down. Deadpan, perfectly straight-faced, teasing only with Xiaoman.

goal.zh: 阿禾说出她为什么等到今天才说（初九说是告状，今天说是对账），或者为什么放马小宝下来。
goal.en: Ahe says why she waited until today (on the ninth it would be telling tales, today it's checking the accounts), or why she let Ma Xiaobao down easy.

text.zh: 初九说，是告状。今天说，是对账。
text.en: On the ninth, saying it is telling tales. Today, saying it is checking the accounts.

text.zh: 拆穿了，他下不来台。他下不来台，他表伯就要下来了。
text.en: Show him up and he can't climb down. If he can't climb down, his uncle will have to come down.

facts.zh: 十月廿二一早，柴房。马小宝带着周衡来翻出一株紫玉参，人又走远了。你（阿禾）冷着脸，一本正经，只对小满俏皮；你初九就知道是怎么回事，一直没说。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Early on the twenty-second of the tenth month, the woodshed. Ma Xiaobao brought Zhou Heng to turn up a purple jade ginseng, and they've gone. You (Ahe) keep a straight face and are playful only with Xiaoman; you knew what happened on the ninth and said nothing. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 宝贝排成一长溜。——打一字。
hints: 她今天来，就为这一个字。

en.q: I have columns but no building, I balance but never fall, and I'm closed at the end of every year. What am I?
hints: Zhou Heng keeps a wall of them.

text.en: You knew on the ninth?

text.zh: 初九说，是告状。今天说，是对账。
text.en: On the ninth, saying it is telling tales. Today, saying it is checking the accounts.
Then why didn't you say?

text.zh: 拆穿了，他下不来台。他下不来台，他表伯就要下来了。
text.en: Show him up and he can't climb down. If he can't climb down, his uncle will have to come down.

setup.zh: 马小宝一甩袖子，带着人走了，走过门口，一脚踢翻了门边的水桶，水泼湿了他自己半条裤腿。
setup.en: Ma Xiaobao flung his sleeve and left with his people, and passing the door he kicked over the water bucket beside it and soaked half of one of his own trouser legs.

when.en: The night before the hidden realm

voice.zh: 自称「本王」，下巴抬着拿鼻孔对人；嘴硬、爱吹，嫌弃凡人不念书；心软，从来不认。
voice.en: Calls herself "this queen", chin up, nostrils at you; stubborn, boastful, scornful of mortals who don't read; soft-hearted, and never admits it.

text.en: What are you crying for?

facts.zh: 进秘境的前一夜，小满把两只手按上饭桶的铜肚子：「给我一样保命的。」他想多送些出的总该好些，送了三十来口，收不住了：药园里断着一根肋骨坐出来的那一层，叫它连底吸了去，回到练气一层；吐出来的是一只木头雕的小牲口，像羊又像骆驼，还追着他咬。他坐在筐上眼圈一红。银月钻出来蹲上筐沿，先理胸前的毛，再嫌他：乡下孩子没见过世面；这破桶喂柴火棍吐牙签，喂鞋底糊一脸；喂仙品，才出仙品。她还有最后一颗仙界臻品，九转还魂丹，从太上老君丹房里「拿」的——其实是抢的。
facts.en: The night before the hidden realm Xiaoman pressed both hands on the Rice Bucket's bronze belly: 'Give me something that'll keep me alive.' Thinking more in meant better out, he fed it thirty-odd mouthfuls and couldn't stop: the layer he sat out in the herb garden with a broken rib was sucked away, bottom and all, back to the first layer; out came a little carved wooden beast, part sheep, part camel, that chased and bit him. He sits on the basket with red eyes. Yinyue crawls out onto the basket's rim, smooths her chest fur first, then scorns him: country boy, never seen the world; this wretched bucket gives toothpicks for firewood and a faceful for a shoe sole; feed it something immortal and you get something immortal. She has one last treasure of the immortal realm, a Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill, 'taken' from the Supreme Old Lord's pill house — robbed, in fact.

goal.zh: 银月说出她还有最后一颗（九转还魂丹），并且认了是「抢的」。
goal.en: Yinyue says she has one last pill (the Nine-Turn Soul-Return Pill), and owns up that she robbed it.

text.zh: 本王还有一颗。最后一颗。
text.en: This queen has one more. The very last one.
Robbed it.

setup.zh: 药园里断着肋骨坐出来的那一层，叫它连底吸了去。练气一层。
setup.en: the layer he had sat out in the herb garden with a broken rib, it had sucked away, bottom and all. First layer of Qi Condensation.

facts.zh: 进秘境的前一夜，柴房。小满喂饭桶喂过了头：药园里断着肋骨坐出来的那一层，叫它连底吸了去，回到练气一层；吐出来的是一只追着他咬的木头小牲口。他坐在筐上眼圈一红。你（银月）蹲上筐沿，先理胸前的毛，再嫌他：乡下孩子没见过世面；这破桶喂柴火棍吐牙签，喂仙品才出仙品。你出了个谜考他，谜底是你身上藏着的一样宝贝——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The night before the hidden realm, the woodshed. Xiaoman overfed the Rice Bucket: the layer he sat out in the herb garden with a broken rib was sucked away, back to the first layer; out came a little wooden beast that chases and bites him. He sits on the basket with red eyes. You (Yinyue) are on the basket's rim, smoothing your chest fur, scorning him: country boy, never seen the world; this wretched bucket gives toothpicks for firewood; feed it something immortal and you get something immortal. You've set him a riddle; its answer is a treasure you keep hidden on you — never let slip a word of it, never guess for him.

zh.q: 龙眼大小圆溜溜，九道金纹自己转；搁在手心热乎乎，仙鹤见了伸脖子。——打一样东西。
hints: 太上老君的丹房里出来的。

en.q: Round as a longan, nine gold lines that turn by themselves; warm in the palm, and cranes crane their necks at it. What is it?
hints: It came out of the Supreme Old Lord's own furnace room.
Swallow it, and it calls a soul back.

text.zh: 本王还有一颗。最后一颗。
text.en: This queen has one more. The very last one.
...Took it?
Robbed it.

title.zh: 沉鼎观 · 外门大通铺
title.en: Chending Temple · the outer court's long bunk

when.en: The last night of the tenth month

voice.zh: 马家佃户的儿子，进门三年，练气二层，瘦长；一天说不上三句话，说也是低着头、短短的，先替马小宝想；心里记着一笔账，不说出口。
voice.en: Son of a Ma family tenant, three years in the sect, second layer, long and thin; doesn't say three sentences a day, and when he does it's short, head down, with Ma Xiaobao in mind first; he keeps a reckoning in his head and never says it.

facts.zh: 十月的最后一夜，三更，泗水一口气没了，秘境明日开门；大通铺上谁也睡不着。马小宝在火盆边嚼完桂花糕，把油纸团一团扔在最边上那张铺上：「崖上掉下去的，都是傻子。」那张铺挨着漏风的窗户，睡的是老蔫：马家佃户的儿子，进门三年，练气二层。他把油纸捡起来展平，叠成方方的一块揣进怀里，预备明早替马小宝扔。十月十二那夜柴房里打到第二十下，五个人里缩回手、低低说了一句「够了」的便是他，从那以后马小宝叫他睡窗户底下。他家租着马家三亩坡田，租子是收成的六成；马三去年跟他爹说：「你家小子跟着小宝，租子减一成。」这一成，他爹记着，他也记着。
facts.en: The last night of the tenth month, the third watch: the Si River vanished at a stroke and the secret realm opens tomorrow; nobody on the long bunk can sleep. By the brazier Ma Xiaobao finishes his osmanthus cakes, balls up the oiled paper and tosses it onto the very last bunk: "The ones who fall off cliffs are idiots." That bunk is under the draughty window and belongs to Old Wilt: son of a Ma tenant, three years in, second layer. He picks the paper up, smooths it, folds it square and tucks it away, to throw out for Ma Xiaobao in the morning. On the night of the twelfth, in the woodshed, at the twentieth blow, the one of the five who pulled his hand back and said low "That's enough" was him, and since then Ma Xiaobao makes him sleep under the window. His family rents three mu of Ma hillside at six tenths of the harvest; last year Ma San told his father: "Your boy follows Xiaobao, your rent comes down a tenth." His father keeps that tenth in mind, and so does he.

goal.zh: 老蔫说出他为什么还跟着马小宝：家里那三亩坡田，跟着小宝，租子减一成。（他只叠油纸、只说「睡吧」，不算。）
goal.en: Old Wilt says why he still follows Ma Xiaobao: the three mu of hillside at home, and the tenth off the rent for following Xiaobao. (While he only folds the paper or says "go to sleep", it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 你家小子跟着小宝，租子减一成。
text.en: Your boy follows Xiaobao, your rent comes down a tenth.

facts.zh: 十月的最后一夜，三更，外门大通铺，秘境明日开门，谁也睡不着。你（老蔫，马家佃户的儿子，进门三年，练气二层，话少，睡在漏风的窗户底下）把马小宝扔来的油纸展平叠好。小满睡不着，你解个闷。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The last night of the tenth month, the third watch, the outer court's long bunk; the hidden realm opens tomorrow and nobody sleeps. You (Old Wilt, son of a Ma tenant, three years in, second layer, few words, sleeping under the draughty window) smooth and fold the oil paper Ma Xiaobao threw at you. Xiaoman can't sleep; you pass the time. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 四个山字山靠山，四个川字川连川。——打一字。

en.q: What has rows but no seats, is fed but never eats, and feeds the ones who feed it?
hints: Your family rents one from the Mas.

text.zh: 你家小子跟着小宝，租子减一成。
text.en: Your boy follows Xiaobao, your rent comes down a tenth.

setup.zh: 最边上那张铺挨着漏风的窗户，睡的是个瘦长的老弟子，人都叫他老蔫。
setup.en: The very last bunk sat under the draughty window, and in it slept a long, thin older disciple everyone called Old Wilt.

title.en: The Si River · before the stone door

when.en: The first of the eleventh month · the hour of the Dragon

text.en: Senior Brother Shen, can I follow you?

chips.en: Follow the crowd. Walk in the middle.

facts.zh: 冬月初一辰时，泗水的河滩上，三百多个外门弟子挤在结霜的黑泥上，木板道一直铺到石门跟前；九层的内门弟子一拂袖子就能把人扔出两三丈。孙二狗零层，灵根差，鼻涕冻成了两道冰溜子，腰上系着他娘缝的蓝布包，露出一截红绳——护身符；他说过大比要上一回，赢一场，写信告诉他娘。他怕一个人进去回不来，要跟着小满。小满背着爷爷那张弓，箭壶里三支自己削的竹箭；他要走没人的地方——没人，就没刀——不能带孙二狗。他包袱里有萝卜。
facts.en: The first of the eleventh month, the hour of the Dragon: on the Si riverbed three hundred outer disciples crowd the frosted black mud, a plank way laid right up to the stone door; an inner ninth-layer can throw a man three yards with a sweep of his sleeve. Sun Ergou is at layer zero with a poor spirit root, his snot frozen into two icicles, the blue cloth bundle his mother sewed tied at his waist with a bit of red string showing: his charm. He has said he will go up once at the tournament, win one bout and write to tell his mother. He is afraid that alone he won't come back, and wants to follow Xiaoman. Xiaoman carries his grandfather's bow and three bamboo arrows of his own whittling; he means to go where there is nobody (no people, no blades) and can't take Sun Ergou. He has radishes in his bundle.

goal.zh: 孙二狗肯跟着人多的走、走中间，不跟小满了（郑重地点头，揣起萝卜）。他还在求着跟你，不算。
goal.en: Sun Ergou agrees to follow the crowd and walk in the middle instead of following Xiaoman (a solemn nod; the radish tucked away). While he is still begging to come with you, it doesn't count.

text.en: ...And you, Senior Brother?

facts.zh: 冬月初一辰时，泗水河滩，三百多人挤在结霜的黑泥上等秘境开门。你（孙二狗，零层，鼻涕冻成冰溜子，腰上系着娘缝的蓝布包）怕一个人进去回不来，想跟着小满；紧张得先出个谜。谜底是他包袱里那样吃的。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The first of the eleventh month, morning, the Sishui mudflat: three hundred and more packed on frosted black mud, waiting for the realm to open. You (Sun Ergou, layer zero, snot frozen into icicles, the blue cloth bag your mother sewed at your waist) are afraid of going in alone and want to follow Xiaoman; nervous, you set a riddle first. The answer is the food in his bundle. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 红公鸡，绿尾巴，一头钻到地底下。——打一样吃的。

en.q: A red rooster with a green tail, diving head first into the ground. What food is it?
hints: You can beg one from the kitchen.

text.en: Follow the crowd. Walk in the middle.
...And you, Senior Brother?

title.en: The Si River · outside the stone door

when.zh: 三天后 · 潮水要回来了
when.en: Three days later · the tide is coming back

text.en: What did you find in there?

chips.en: I only found a pinch of earth.

facts.zh: 三天后，潮水要回来了，秘境的人一个一个从石门里出来；进去四百一十七个，出来的一个比一个少。阿禾蹲在河滩上一块石头旁边等他。她在暗河尽头的黑地里抠出三粒很老的黑谷——有人在秘境里种过地；她贴隐身符躲过邹青松，给他报过信（「他杀人，只使葫芦」），后来又在墙缝里撒谷、扔出师父给的冰锥符和镇岳符；她的右手一直拢在袖子里，掌心一片燎泡。她没跟人说这些。她只想知道：凶崖墙后头的风，他用上了没有。小满身上：烧穿了的袄子，小腿上一块焦黑的裤脚；息壤长进了他身子里，他四层了，这件事他要藏。
facts.en: Three days on, the tide is coming back and the realm's people come out of the stone door one by one, fewer and fewer of the four hundred and seventeen who went in. Ahe is crouched by a rock on the riverbed, waiting for him. At the end of the underground river she dug three very old black grains out of the black ground: somebody farmed in the secret realm. She hid from Zou Qingsong under a concealing talisman and warned Xiaoman ("he only kills with the gourd"), then scattered grain from the crack and threw her Master's ice-spike and mountain-weight talismans; her right hand has stayed drawn up in her sleeve all along, the palm all blisters. She has told no one any of this. She only wants to know whether he used the wind behind the Deadly Cliff's wall. On Xiaoman: a burned-through jacket, a scorched trouser leg; the living soil has grown into him and he is at the fourth layer, which he means to hide.

goal.zh: 阿禾摊开那三粒谷，问出「风，用上了？」，小满答了。（她只问「你在里头捡到什么了」，不算。）
goal.en: Ahe opens her cloth on the three grains and asks "The wind. Did you use it?", and Xiaoman answers. (While she only asks what he found, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 我捡到三粒谷子，是很老很老的谷子。
text.en: I found three grains. Very, very old grains.
The wind. Did you use it?

facts.zh: 三天后，潮水要回来了，秘境里的人一个一个从石门出来，一个比一个少。你（阿禾）蹲在河滩一块石头旁边等他，右手一直拢在袖子里。你在黑地里抠出过一样东西，不跟人说。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Three days on, the tide about to return; one by one they come out of the stone gate, fewer each time. You (Ahe) crouch by a rock on the mudflat waiting for him, your right hand kept in your sleeve. In the dark you dug something up and have told no one. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 一粒埋土里，千粒挂穗上；脱了黄衣裳，就是碗里的饭。——打一样东西。
hints: 她手心里攥着三粒，很老很老的。

en.q: One buried in the earth, a thousand on the ear; take off its yellow coat and it's the meal in your bowl. What is it?
hints: She has three in her palm, very, very old.

text.en: I only found a pinch of earth.

text.zh: 我捡到三粒谷子，是很老很老的谷子。
text.en: I found three grains. Very, very old grains.
The wind. Did you use it?

title.zh: 沉鼎观 · 伙房门口 · 押宝板
title.en: Chending Temple · the kitchen door · the betting board

when.en: The seventh of the twelfth month

voice.zh: 坊市的老江湖，绸袄洗得发白，左手算盘右手秤；爱讲「明码标价，童叟无欺」，嘴上吃亏，心里有数；看东西的时候不说话。
voice.en: An old hand of the market in a faded silk jacket, abacus in the left hand, steelyard in the right; fond of "prices marked plain, no cheating young or old"; loses every argument out loud and none in his head; says nothing while he looks a thing over.

text.en: Let me heft it.

chips.zh: 掌柜的，一赔一百，怎么算的？
chips.en: Shopkeeper, a hundred to one, how's that worked out?

facts.zh: 腊月初七，大比前一天，伙房门口老槐树底下支着押宝板：宗门大比押冠军。钱掌柜（坊市押宝的，十押九赔，每年给观里交十块灵石摊钱）一手算盘一手秤。板上写着：沈小满，一赔一百——杂灵根、进门三个月、头一回上台，三样占全，该写一赔一千，他写一百，剩下九百是他的。他眼皮一抬，落在小满背上那张弓上：爷爷的弓，牛筋十七道，值三钱银子；弦是新的，值五十文；那木头，他认不出来。他想知道那是什么木头：谁打听出名字告诉他，他照价收，一文不少。
facts.en: The seventh of the twelfth month, the day before the contest: under the old locust tree at the kitchen door stands the betting board, "Bets on the sect champion". Shopkeeper Qian (the market's bookmaker; nine in ten bets he pays out on, he says; ten stones a year to the temple for the pitch) holds an abacus and a steelyard. The board reads: Shen Xiaoman, a hundred to one: mixed spirit root, three months in, first time up, all three at once; it ought to be a thousand to one, he writes a hundred and keeps the other nine hundred. His eyes fall on the bow on Xiaoman's back: the grandfather's bow, seventeen layers of ox sinew worth three qian of silver, a new string worth fifty coppers, and a wood he cannot name. He wants that name; whoever brings it, he'll pay its price, not a copper short.

goal.zh: 钱掌柜掂过那张弓，说出他叫不出那木头的名字，要小满打听出来告诉他，照价收。（他只报赔率，不算。）
goal.en: Shopkeeper Qian weighs the bow and admits he can't name its wood, and asks Xiaoman to find out and tell him, at a price. (While he only quotes odds, it doesn't count.)

text.en: I can't put a name to it.

text.zh: 一个名字，我照价收，一文不少你的。
text.en: A name, I'll buy at its price, and not a copper short.

facts.zh: 腊月初七，大比前一天，伙房门口老槐树底下的押宝板。你（钱掌柜，坊市押宝的，十押九赔，一手算盘一手秤）掂着小满背上爷爷那张弓：牛筋、弦都估得出价，只那木头你认不出来。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The seventh of the twelfth month, the day before the contest, the betting board under the old locust tree by the kitchen. You (Shopkeeper Qian, the market's bookmaker, pay out nine bets in ten, an abacus in one hand and a steelyard in the other) are weighing Grandfather's bow on Xiaoman's back: the sinew and string you can price; the wood you can't place. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 什么东西是你的，别人用得比你多？
hints: 人人都有一个，生下来就有。

en.q: What belongs to you, yet others use it far more than you do?
hints: Everyone has one, from the day they are born.
Can't call it, can't place a man.

text.en: I can't put a name to it.

text.zh: 一个名字，我照价收，一文不少你的。
text.en: A name, I'll buy at its price, and not a copper short.

title.zh: 沉鼎观 · 大比 · 台角的水缸
title.en: Chending Temple · the contest · the water vat

when.en: The eighth of the twelfth month · the third round

text.en: You didn't hang on it. I remember.

chips.en: Senior Sister Qin. That time in the secret realm...

facts.zh: 腊月初八，大比第三轮：小满对秦雁。台角的水缸边上两个人碰上了，她舀了半瓢水递给他。秘境里那一回，是她拿剑鞘把小满和孙二狗从翻板坑里拉上来的（小满没往下坠）。秦雁内门八层，真灵根，使剑，前两回大比都打进前四，都输在祁长松手上；她八层卡了两年。她爹前年叫熊把腿咬了，躺到如今，凡药接不上；坊市上三道纹的回春丹接得上，一颗二百块灵石，她一月份例十块。筑了基，丹房肯赊；练气的开口，没人听。头名那颗筑基丹，她非拿不可。她不会让，也不要他让。
facts.en: The eighth of the twelfth month, the contest's third round: Xiaoman against Qin Yan. By the water vat at the stage's corner the two meet; she scoops half a ladle and hands it to him. In the secret realm it was her scabbard that pulled Xiaoman and Sun Ergou out of the tipping pit (Xiaoman didn't hang on it). Qin Yan: inner sect, eighth layer, true spirit root, a sword; in both earlier contests she reached the last four and lost to Qi Changsong; two years stuck at eighth. A bear bit her pa's leg two years ago and he is still in bed; ordinary medicine can't mend it; a three-line Spring-Return Pill at the market can, two hundred stones, and her allowance is ten a month. With a foundation the pill house gives credit; a Qi Condensation disciple, nobody listens. She has to take the first-place Foundation Pill. She won't give way, and doesn't want him to.

goal.zh: 秦雁说出她为什么非拿头名不可（她爹的腿、八层卡了两年），并说「我不让你。你也别让我。」（她只递水，不算。）
goal.en: Qin Yan says why she must take first place (her pa's leg, two years stuck at eighth) and says "I won't give way to you. Don't you give way to me either." (While she only hands him water, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 你知道我为什么非拿这个头名不可？
text.en: Do you know why I have to have first place?
I won't give way to you. Don't you give way to me either.

facts.zh: 腊月初八，大比第三轮前，台角边。你（秦雁，内门八层，真灵根，使剑，话少，眼尖）秘境里拿剑鞘把他从翻板坑里拉上来过。等着上台，你递给他半瓢东西。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The eighth of the twelfth month, before the third round, at the corner of the stage. You (Qin Yan, inner court, eighth layer, true root, swordswoman, few words, sharp eyes) pulled him out of a trapdoor pit with your scabbard in the realm. Waiting to go up, you hand him half a ladle of something. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 用手拿不起，用刀劈不开；煮饭和洗衣，都要请它来。——打一样东西。

en.q: You can't pick it up in your hand or split it with a knife, yet cooking and washing both call for it. What is it?
hints: The vat is full of it.
She has just ladled you half a scoop.

text.en: Senior Sister Qin. That time in the secret realm...

text.zh: 你知道我为什么非拿这个头名不可？
text.en: Do you know why I have to have first place?
I won't give way to you. Don't you give way to me either.

title.zh: 沉鼎观 · 大比 · 决赛
title.en: Chending Temple · the contest · the final

when.zh: 腊月初八 · 日头挨着西边山尖
when.en: The eighth of the twelfth month · the sun on the western peaks

voice.zh: 内门九层，四十来岁，方脸，眼皮半睁半闭，人称「祁不退」；话极少，一句一句平平的，像踩实了一步再迈下一步；等一颗筑基丹等了二十年。
voice.en: Inner sect, ninth layer, forty or so, square-faced, eyes half shut, called "Qi Who Never Steps Back"; speaks very little, each sentence flat, as if planting one foot before the next; has waited twenty years for a Foundation Pill.

text.en: That beam of Junior Brother Ma's. You caught it.

facts.zh: 决赛：沈小满（外门四层，左臂叫秦雁的剑犁开一道口子，新缠了布条，右手攥着拳藏在袖子里）对祁长松（内门九层，人称「祁不退」，在内门往前走了二十年，没退过一步，等那颗筑基丹等了二十年）。半决里小满拿一面破自拍镜接住了马小宝那一镜，光倒打回去，马小宝一脸的斑烙白了。祁长松看了一眼小满的袖子。大比不许伤人性命；祁长松不打算伤他，只打算一步一步把他送下台。香点着了。
facts.en: The final: Shen Xiaoman (outer sect, fourth layer, left arm gashed by Qin Yan's sword and freshly bound, right hand clenched in a fist hidden in his sleeve) against Qi Changsong (inner sect, ninth layer, "Qi Who Never Steps Back", twenty years walking forward in the inner sect without a step back, twenty years waiting for this pill). In the semi-final Xiaoman caught Ma Xiaobao's beam on a broken selfie mirror and the light turned back and branded Ma Xiaobao's blotches white. Qi Changsong glances at Xiaoman's sleeve. The contest forbids taking life; he doesn't mean to hurt him, only to walk him off the stage step by step. The incense is lit.

goal.zh: 祁长松说出他不伤小满，要把他送下台（「我不伤你。我送你下去。」）。（他只看着，不说话，不算。）
goal.en: Qi Changsong says he won't hurt Xiaoman and will see him off the stage ("I won't hurt you. I'll see you off the stage."). (While he only looks and says nothing, it doesn't count.)

text.en: I won't hurt you. I'll see you off the stage.

facts.zh: 决赛台上：小满（外门四层，左臂缠着布条，右手攥拳藏在袖子里）对你（祁长松，内门九层，人称「祁不退」，二十年没退过一步）。台边计时的东西点着了。你话少，不打算伤他。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The final: Xiaoman (outer court, fourth layer, a strip of cloth round his left arm, his right fist hidden in his sleeve) against you (Qi Changsong, inner court, ninth layer, 'Qi Never-Back', not one step back in twenty years). The thing that times the bout is lit at the stage's edge. You say little and don't mean to hurt him. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 细细一根身，头上一点红；不点不冒烟，烧完一场完。——打一样东西。

en.q: A thin body with a red tip; it smokes only when lit, and when it's burnt down, the bout is done. What is it?
hints: It's burning at the stage's edge.
You count them by the stick.

text.en: He shone himself dry.
I won't hurt you. I'll see you off the stage.

when.en: Laba · after dark

text.en: Accounts close at Laba. They close in the evening.

facts.zh: 腊八天黑，周衡在执事房点上半根蜡烛，翻开巡夜簿一行一行念：十月初一至初九，药园丢灵草十株；初八起沈小满巡夜；初十以后，一株没丢，外加灵兽一只，狰，入册。十月里说的「另议」，今天议：他从抽屉里一块一块数出十块灵石。小满看着灵石没伸手。周衡只认账，句句带数；他难得多说一句《礼记》：年底祭「蜡」，连吃田鼠的猫都请来谢——用过人家的，一定要还。大比小满输了决赛，阿禾押他的那一文也输了。
facts.en: Laba, after dark: Zhou Heng lights the half candle in the stewards' office and reads down the night-watch book line by line: first to ninth of the tenth month, ten spirit herbs lost; from the eighth, Shen Xiaoman on watch; after the tenth, not one lost, plus one spirit beast, a zheng, entered. The item "to be settled separately" in the tenth month is settled today: he counts ten spirit stones out of the drawer, one at a time. Xiaoman looks at them and doesn't reach. Zhou Heng trusts only accounts, a number in every sentence; for once he quotes the *Book of Rites*: at the year's end even the cats that ate the field mice were thanked; what you have used, you pay back. Xiaoman lost the final today; Ahe's one coin on him was lost too.

goal.zh: 周衡说出「用过人家的，一定要还」或「连猫的账，都结」，把十块灵石推给小满。（他只念账，不算。）
goal.en: Zhou Heng says "what you've used, you must pay back" or "even the cats' accounts get settled" and pushes the ten stones over. (While he only reads the book, it doesn't count.)

text.en: When you've used what's someone else's, you must pay it back.
Even the cats' accounts get settled.

facts.zh: 腊八天黑，执事房，半根蜡烛。你（周衡，只认账，句句带数）翻开巡夜簿：初十以后药园一株没丢，外加灵兽一只入册；抽屉里十块灵石。今天你难得多说一句。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Dark on the Laba festival, the stewards' office, half a candle. You (Zhou Heng, trust only the accounts, every sentence a number) open the night-watch book: from the tenth not one plant lost, plus one spirit beast entered in the roll; ten spirit stones in the drawer. Today, for once, you say a little more. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 上一层，下一层，珠子挨着珠子坐；手指一拨噼啪响，一年的账就清楚了。——打一样东西。

en.q: An upper floor and a lower floor, beads sitting shoulder to shoulder; flick them and they clack, and the year's accounts come out clear. What is it?
hints: No counting room is without one.
Shopkeeper Qian holds one in his hand.

text.en: ...Senior Brother Zhou.
When you've used what's someone else's, you must pay it back.
Even the cats' accounts get settled.

title.zh: 城里的医院 · 十七床

when.zh: 十一月二十六日 · 下午
when.en: The twenty-sixth of November · afternoon

text.en: This is where you started.

facts.zh: 沈芒「闭关三日」：背着阿禾，晚上七点上健身房练到十点，深蹲一天比一天多；第三天早上晨脉八十八（平时七十上下），他当是气血旺；阿禾回了一句「88？今天别练。」他回「好，不练」，又蹲了一百。夜里尿成可乐色：横纹肌溶解，肌酸激酶四万二，住院，十七床，半决赛（二十八号）上不了。阿禾下了课来，在床尾坐下，翻过一张输液单。她要讲给他：练，是挖坑；歇好了、吃饱了、睡足了，身子把坑填平，还多填一截，那一截才是长出来的；他一个坑没填，又往下挖了两天；晨脉高一截，是身子在说前一天的账还没还完；雷老师的话：加量，一个礼拜最多加一成。
facts.en: Shen Mang's "three days in seclusion": behind Ahe's back, gym from seven to ten every night, more squats each day; on the third morning his resting pulse was eighty-eight (usually around seventy) and he took it for vigour; Ahe texted "88? Don't train today." He replied "OK, I won't," and did another hundred. That night his urine was cola-coloured: rhabdomyolysis, CK at forty-two thousand, hospital, bed seventeen, no semi-final on the twenty-eighth. Ahe comes after class, sits at the foot of the bed and turns over an infusion chart. What she means to show him: training digs a pit; with rest, food and sleep the body fills it and a bit more, and that bit is the growth; he didn't fill one pit and dug two more days down; a high morning pulse is the body saying yesterday's account isn't paid; Coach Lei's rule: add a tenth a week at most.

goal.zh: 阿禾讲明白那个八十八是什么——身子在喊停，前一天的账还没还完（坑没填，又往下挖）。（她只画线不说话，不算。）
goal.en: Ahe makes clear what the eighty-eight was: the body shouting stop, yesterday's account unpaid (a pit not filled, dug deeper). (While she only draws and says nothing, it doesn't count.)

text.en: Training is digging a pit.

text.zh: 你一个坑没填，又往下挖了两天。
text.en: You didn't fill in one pit, and then you dug two more days down.

facts.zh: 城里的医院，十七床，十一月二十六日下午。沈芒背着你（阿禾）在健身房连练三夜，第三天晨脉八十八，你回过「88？今天别练。」他回「好，不练」，又蹲了一百；夜里尿成可乐色，横纹肌溶解，住院，半决赛上不了。你下了课来，在床尾坐下，翻过一张输液单，画了一道横线：「这是你原来的样子。」你要他自己想明白，先出了个谜——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。你说话短，现代人的话。
facts.en: The city hospital, bed seventeen, the afternoon of 26 November. Behind your (Ahe's) back Shen Mang trained three nights running; on the third morning his pulse was eighty-eight; you texted '88? Don't train today.' He replied 'OK, I won't,' and did another hundred; that night, cola-coloured urine, rhabdomyolysis, hospital, no semi-final. You come after class, sit at the foot of the bed, turn over an infusion chart and draw a level line: 'This is where you started.' You want him to work it out himself, so first you set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him. You speak briefly, in plain modern words.

zh.q: 什么东西，越挖越大？

en.q: What gets bigger the more you take away from it?

text.en: Training is digging a pit.

text.zh: 你一个坑没填，又往下挖了两天。
text.en: You didn't fill in one pit, and then you dug two more days down.

when.en: The third day · holding

text.zh: 先掐好，扣在手里，要用的时候，一松。
text.en: Pinch it first, hold it in your hand, and when you need it, let go.

facts.zh: 第三天，褚先生教扣：拇指掐着午文不动，四个指头一收，攥成半个拳，拳心里透出一点红；扣着的手什么也干不了，气一丝一丝从指缝里漏，扣得久了自己就散了。能扣多久看手紧不紧：四层一炷香，六层小半个时辰。扣诀三条规矩：一只手扣一样，两只手最多两样；松了一样要从头抡，所以台上打架，打的是谁先用完；别叫人看见你扣的是什么——拳心透红是火、透白是金、透青是木、透一点墨色是水、透黄是土。小满在最后一排算账：人有两只手。
facts.en: On the third day Master Chu teaches holding: thumb on the wu mark, four fingers closed into half a fist, a little red showing through; the holding hand can do nothing else, the qi leaks between the fingers, and held too long it scatters. How long depends on how tight the hand is: fourth layer, one incense stick; sixth, the best part of an hour. Three rules: one hand holds one thing, two hands two at most; let one go and you swing from the start, so a fight on the stage is about who runs out first; never let anyone see what you hold: red through the fist is fire, white metal, green wood, ink-black water, yellow earth. In the back row Xiaoman does his sums: a person has two hands.

goal.zh: 褚先生说出扣诀的规矩（一只手扣一样；松了要从头抡；别叫人看见你扣的是什么）。（他只说「先掐好」，不算。）
goal.en: Master Chu gives the rules of holding (one hand, one thing; once let go, swing from the start; never show what you hold). (While he only says "pinch it first", it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 别叫人看见你扣的是什么。
text.en: don't let anyone see what you're holding.
Grip it close.

facts.zh: 讲堂，第三天，你（褚先生）教扣：拇指掐着午文，四指一收攥成半个拳，拳心透出一点颜色；扣着的那只什么也干不了。讲规矩之前，先叫他猜个谜。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The lecture hall, the third day. You (Master Chu) teach holding: the thumb pinned on the noon mark, the rest closing in, a colour showing through; what holds can do nothing else. Before the rules, a riddle. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 五个兄弟，住在一起；名字不同，高矮不齐。——打一样东西。

en.q: Five brothers living in one house, each with his own name, none the same height. What are they?
hints: The hold is made inside it.

text.zh: 别叫人看见你扣的是什么。
text.en: don't let anyone see what you're holding.
Grip it close.

when.en: The fifteenth of the twelfth month

text.en: You have to go with it. Follow it.

chips.zh: 师父，九宫八个字，为什么头一个教巽？
chips.en: Master, of the eight words in the nine palaces, why teach Xun first?

facts.zh: 崖顶青石上，瞿老拿秃扫帚把画了九格（戴九履一，左三右七，二四为肩，六八为足，五居中央），一格一个字：坎是水，艮是山，震是雷，巽是风。他掰一片干叶子让小满拿火柴砍，砍了四五剑一回也没砍着；瞿老拿扫帚把跟着叶子的路慢慢往下走，叶子正落在扫帚把尖上。为什么先教巽，两样：小满是徐州人，巽四是徐州宫；第二样，巽的卦是底下一道断、上头两道整——底下虚，上头实，软的在底下；天底下最软的东西，什么地方都钻得进去。《道德经》：「天下之至柔，驰骋天下之至坚。无有入无间。」水是这样，风是这样。巽，就一个字：入。
facts.en: On the bluestone at the clifftop Elder Qu drew nine squares with a bald broom handle (nine on the head, one at the feet, three left, seven right, two and four the shoulders, six and eight the feet, five in the middle), one word a square: Kan is water, Gen mountain, Zhen thunder, Xun wind. He snapped a dry leaf and had Xiaoman cut at it with Matchstick: four or five cuts, not one touched it; Elder Qu followed its path down with the broom handle and the leaf landed on the tip. Why Xun first, two reasons: Xiaoman is from Xu Province and Xun Four is the Xu palace; second, Xun's figure is a broken line below and two whole above: empty below, solid above, the soft underneath; the softest thing under heaven gets in anywhere. *Daodejing*: "The softest thing under heaven gallops through the hardest. What has no substance enters where there is no gap." Water is like that, wind too. Xun is one word: enter.

goal.zh: 瞿老讲出为什么头一个教巽（徐州宫；底下虚、上头实，最软的东西哪儿都钻得进去），落到一个字：入。（他只叫你再砍叶子，不算。）
goal.en: Elder Qu says why Xun comes first (the Xu palace; empty below, solid above, the softest thing gets in anywhere) and lands on one word: enter. (While he only has you cut at the leaf again, it doesn't count.)

text.en: Xun is one word: enter.

facts.zh: 崖顶青石上，你（瞿老）拿秃扫帚把画了九格，一格一个字：坎、艮、震……他拿火柴砍一片干叶子，砍了四五剑一回没砍着；你拿扫帚把跟着叶子的路慢慢往下走，叶子正落在扫帚把尖上：「你得随它，跟着它走。」头一个要教他的那一格，先叫他猜一个谜——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。你话少，慢，像山里的老人。
facts.en: On the bluestone at the clifftop you (Elder Qu) have drawn nine squares with a bald broom handle, a word to each. He hacked at a dry leaf with a matchstick four or five times and never hit it; you followed the leaf's path down with the broom handle and it settled on the tip: 'You have to go with it. Follow it.' Before teaching the first square, you set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him. You say little, slowly, like an old man of the mountains.

zh.q: 看不见，抓不住；门缝再细，它也钻得进去。——打一样东西。
hints: 方才那片叶子，就是跟着它打转。

en.q: It can't be seen or caught, yet it slips in through the narrowest crack of a door. What is it?
hints: That leaf just now turned on it.
In the trigrams, Xun is this.

text.zh: 师父，九宫八个字，为什么头一个教巽？
text.en: Master, of the eight words in the nine palaces, why teach Xun first?
Xun is one word: enter.

when.en: The first month

voice.zh: 独臂，守执事堂，坐在门槛上编草鞋；话少，头也不抬，一句一句硬邦邦的；牌子上画过多少道黑线，他都记得。
voice.en: One-armed, keeper of the Stewards' Hall, weaving straw sandals on the threshold; says little without looking up, every sentence hard; remembers every black line ever drawn on a tablet.

text.en: Understand it?

facts.zh: 执事堂在正殿西边，一间空屋，两面墙。东墙乌木牌是外门杂役（帮厨、挑水、看丹炉……），工钱记「功」；西墙是内门的：白木采办，黄木护送，红木除妖（五层以下不许揭），青木寻人。翻过来的牌背面一个朱红「讫」，底下钉一块小牌写几个人名，有的名字底下画一道黑线。墙最高一排单钉一块黑牌，只刻地名「泗水 · 渡口」。守堂的邓执事独臂，坐在门槛上编草鞋。黑线：牌子揭了，人没回来——内门三十年，十一道。黑牌一年挂一块，顶多两块，牌上不写事，事当面说；九层以后再来看。小满四层。
facts.en: The Stewards' Hall west of the main hall: an empty room, two walls. East, black ebony tablets for outer-sect chores (kitchen, water, watching the pill furnace...), paid in merit; west, the inner sect's: white for buying, yellow for escort, red for demons (none below fifth layer), green for finding people. A tablet turned over shows a red "done", with a small tablet of names under it, some names with a black line beneath. On the topmost row hangs one black tablet carved only with a place: "The Si River · The Ferry". Steward Deng, one-armed, weaves sandals on the threshold. A black line: the tablet taken, the man not back; eleven in thirty years of the inner sect. A black tablet goes up once a year, twice at most; it says no job, he tells it face to face; come back after ninth layer. Xiaoman is fourth.

goal.zh: 邓执事说出黑线是什么（牌子揭了，人没回来），或说出黑牌的事（九层以后再来看）。（他只编草鞋不搭理，不算。）
goal.en: Steward Deng says what a black line means (taken, and the man never came back), or about the black tablet (come back after ninth layer). (While he only weaves and ignores you, it doesn't count.)

text.en: The tablet was taken and the man didn't come back.
Come and look again after the ninth layer.

facts.zh: 执事堂，一间空屋，两面墙的牌子，有的名字底下画一道黑线。守堂的你（邓执事，独臂，坐在门槛上，手里编着东西，不爱搭理人）。小满四层。谜底就是你手里编的。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The stewards' hall, an empty room, two walls of tokens, a black line under some names. You keep it (Steward Deng, one arm, sitting on the threshold weaving something, not one for talk). Xiaoman is at the fourth layer. The answer is what you're weaving. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 两只小船各西东，十个客人坐船中；白天来往人间走，晚上停在床底下。——打一样东西。

en.q: Two little boats going their own ways, ten passengers inside; by day they walk among people, by night they moor under the bed. What are they?

text.en: The black lines are...
The tablet was taken and the man didn't come back.
Come and look again after the ninth layer.

when.en: Spring · noon of the third day

text.zh: 听说你手里有丹。拿一颗我看看。
text.en: I hear you've got pills. Let me see one.

chips.zh: 丹师，十颗只出两颗，另外八颗呢？
chips.en: Pill-master, if only two out of ten come out, what about the other eight?

facts.zh: 丹房在正殿西北角，矮屋，墙根熏黑；闵丹师筑基圆满，守这口炉三十年，卡在结丹门外十来年，谁的面子也不给；观里的份例丹、大比那颗筑基丹都出自他的炉，一炉十颗，出两颗一纹的。「看丹炉」的牌子挂了三年，来问过的不下十个，他叫进屋闻一炉药就打发走了。外头传小满手里有好丹。小满身上只有一颗饭桶吐的两道纹聚气丹（九道那颗在阿禾怀里）；饭桶的事他得藏。闵丹师看出这丹没有火气，「不是炉里出来的，像是地里长出来的」。他炼丹靠鼻子：药下去先苦，苦里透甜，甜里冒一丝焦——那一丝只有半口气的工夫，早一口药没熟，晚一口一炉全废；来过的人，鼻子都差在这半口气上。
facts.en: The pill house in the north-west corner of the main hall: a low room, walls blackened. Pill-master Min, foundation complete, has kept this furnace thirty years and been stuck outside Core Formation for ten, and does no one favours; the temple's allowance pills and the contest's Foundation Pill all come from his furnace; ten a firing, two come out one-line. The "watch the pill furnace" tablet has hung three years; over ten came to ask, and he sent each off after one sniff of a firing. Word is Xiaoman has good pills. All he carries is one two-line Qi-Gathering Pill the Rice Bucket spat out (the nine-line one is with Ahe); the Rice Bucket he must hide. Min sees the pill has no fire in it: "not out of a furnace, as if it grew out of the ground". He makes pills by nose: first bitter, bitter going sweet, then a wisp of scorch that lasts half a breath; a breath early and it isn't done, a breath late and the whole firing is lost; everyone who came fell short by that half breath.

goal.zh: 闵丹师说出闻药的那半口气（先苦、透甜、冒一丝焦；早一口没熟，晚一口全废）。小满不说出饭桶。（他只问丹从哪儿来，不算。）
goal.en: Pill-master Min explains the half breath of smelling (bitter, sweet, then a wisp of scorch; a breath early not done, a breath late all lost). Xiaoman doesn't give away the Rice Bucket. (While he only asks where the pill came from, it doesn't count.)

text.en: didn't come out of a furnace.
The fire's wrong

facts.zh: 丹房，矮屋，墙根熏黑。你（闵丹师，筑基圆满，守着这口家伙三十年，谁的面子也不给）听说小满手里有好丹，叫他进来。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The pill house, a low room, its walls smoked black. You (Pill-master Min, Foundation complete, thirty years tending this thing, no one's favours count) heard Xiaoman has good pills and called him in. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 三条腿，大肚皮；肚里烧火不怕烫，头顶一个盖，吃进草根吐出丹。——打一样东西。

en.q: Three legs and a big belly; fire inside that never burns it, a lid on top; it eats roots and spits out pills. What is it?
hints: It stands in the middle of the pill house.

text.en: didn't come out of a furnace.
The fire's wrong

title.zh: 坊市 · 钱掌柜的铺子

when.zh: 那年腊月 · 上了板以后
when.en: That twelfth month · after the shutters went up

voice.zh: 坊市的老江湖，一手算盘；爱讲「来路不问，童叟无欺」，嘴上吃亏，心里有数；看东西的时候不说话。
voice.en: An old hand of the market, abacus in hand; fond of "no questions where it came from, no cheating young or old"; loses every argument out loud and none in his head; silent while he looks a thing over.

facts.zh: 那年腊月，小满下山去坊市，等钱掌柜的铺子上了板，从后门进去，把一只小瓦罐放在柜台上：一年攒下的回春丹（饭桶开的），一道纹两道纹，二十来颗。钱掌柜一颗一颗捻过，对着灯看，拨了半天算盘：一百四十块灵石（内门一年份例一百二十）。三纹往上的好东西，他这铺子收不起，在彭城的拍卖会上，一年一回。他从不问来路，这些丹在坊市上当好货卖，谁问是谁炼的，也是「来路不问，童叟无欺」。小满要拿灵石买保命的东西（遁符、飞剑、软甲）：大比那夜银月说过，镜子那头的人找的是她。
facts.en: That twelfth month Xiaoman goes down to the market, waits till Shopkeeper Qian's shutters are up, comes in the back door and sets a little clay jar on the counter: a year's Spring-Return Pills (the Rice Bucket's), one-line and two-line, twenty or so. Qian rolls each between his fingers, looks at it against the lamp, clicks the abacus a long while: a hundred and forty stones (a year's inner-sect allowance is a hundred and twenty). Three lines and up his shop can't afford; those go to the Pengcheng auction, once a year. He never asks where things come from; these pills sell as good stock, and asked who made them, it's "no questions, no cheating young or old". Xiaoman means to spend on things that keep him alive (a flight talisman, a flying sword, armour): on the contest night Yinyue said the one behind the mirror is looking for her.

goal.zh: 钱掌柜给这罐丹报出价钱（一百四十块），并说出三纹往上的好东西要去彭城的拍卖会。（他只捻丹看灯，不算。）
goal.en: Shopkeeper Qian names his price for the jar (a hundred and forty) and says that three-line pills and better go to the Pengcheng auction. (While he only rolls them under the lamp, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 好东西，不在我这儿，在彭城的拍卖会上，一年一回。
text.en: Good things don't stay with me. They go to the auction at Pengcheng, once a year.

facts.zh: 那年腊月，坊市，铺子上了板，后门进来的。你（钱掌柜，来路不问，童叟无欺）捻过柜台上那一罐丹，一颗一颗对着亮看，拨了半天算盘。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: That twelfth month, the market, the shop boarded up, in by the back door. You (Shopkeeper Qian, no questions about where things come from, fair to young and old) roll each pill of the jar on the counter, hold them up to the light, and click your abacus a long while. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 小小一个人，身穿白衣裳；点着头上火，越烧越短了。——打一样东西。

en.q: A little man in a white coat; light his head and he grows shorter as he weeps. What is he?
hints: There's one burning on the counter.
His tears are wax, not water.

text.zh: 好东西，不在我这儿，在彭城的拍卖会上，一年一回。
text.en: Good things don't stay with me. They go to the auction at Pengcheng, once a year.

setup.zh: 小满等铺子上了板，才从后门进去，把一只小瓦罐放在柜台上，罐里是一年攒下的回春丹，一道纹的、两道纹的，二十来颗。
setup.en: Xiaoman waited till the shutters went up and came in by the back door, and set a small clay jar on the counter: a year's saved Spring-Return Pills, one-line and two-line, twenty or so.

when.en: Year six · spring

text.en: 'Now gold elixir, as a thing': next line.

chips.en: The longer it burns, the finer its changes.

facts.zh: 年六，小满十七岁，练气七层，白天替丹房的闵丹师看炉、碾药。这年开春闵丹师头一回不叫他碾药，先考书：那本《金丹》小满抄过三遍，夜里在柴房里也背。闵丹师坐在炉子跟前，眼睛不离炉口。书上那句是：「夫金丹之为物，烧之愈久，变化愈妙。黄金入火，百炼不消，埋之，毕天不朽。」小满只懂一半（烧得越久越好）。闵丹师要的是下一句：黄金入火，百炼不消——烧得久的前头，先得经得起烧；经不起的烧一回是灰，经得起的烧一回多一转。丹是这样，料也是这样。说完他会倒一捆石菖蒲叫小满挑。
facts.en: Year six; Xiaoman is seventeen, seventh layer, and by day watches the furnace and grinds for Pill-master Min. This spring Min, for the first time, tests him on the book before any grinding: Xiaoman has copied *The Gold Elixir* three times and recites it in the woodshed at night. Min sits by the furnace, eyes never leaving its mouth. The passage: "Now gold elixir, as a thing: the longer it burns, the finer its changes. Gold goes into the fire and a hundred smeltings don't consume it; bury it, and to the end of heaven it won't rot." Xiaoman understands half (burn longer, better). What Min wants is the next line: gold in the fire is not consumed; before burning long, a thing must stand the burning; what can't is ash after one burning, what can is one turn more each time. Pills are like that, and ingredients too. Then he will tip out a bundle of sweet flag for Xiaoman to sort.

goal.zh: 闵丹师讲出要紧的那一句：先得经得起烧（经不起的烧一回是灰，经得起的多一转）。（小满背出了下一句、只得了个「对了一半」，不算。）
goal.en: Pill-master Min gives the line that matters: first it has to stand the burning (what can't is ash, what can gains a turn). (Reciting the next line and getting "half right", it doesn't count.)

text.en: Half right.

text.zh: 烧得久的前头，先得经得起烧。
text.en: Before burning long, it first has to stand the burning.

facts.zh: 年六，小满十七岁，练气七层，白天替丹房的你（闵丹师）看炉、碾药。你坐在炉子跟前，眼睛不离炉口；话短，冷，只认对错。你要讲的是「经得起烧」。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Year six; Xiaoman is seventeen, seventh layer, minding the furnace and grinding herbs for you (Pill-master Min) by day. You sit at the furnace, eyes never off its mouth; brief, cold, only right and wrong count. What you mean to teach is 'standing the burning'. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 入火烧不化，埋土烂不了；人人都想要，越炼越是好。——打一样东西。
hints: 埋上千年，挖出来还是亮的。

en.q: Fire can't melt it away, the earth can't rot it; everyone wants it, and the more it's refined the better. What is it?
hints: Buried a thousand years, it comes up shining.

text.zh: 烧得久的前头，先得经得起烧。
text.en: Before burning long, it first has to stand the burning.

when.en: The eighth month · after sundown

text.en: Which pill will you use?

facts.zh: 小满九层圆满，九月初三要冲筑基（进山门满六年差六天，想赶回去告诉他娘）。瞿老刚说过：渡口那一回你是爬着上来的；练气的腿跑不过筑基的剑。小满手里有两颗丹：一颗是大比赢来、观里赏的筑基丹（一转，下品，全天下唯一说得清来历的）；一颗是五年前一根萝卜从饭桶里换来的九转筑基丹，压在储物袋最底下。饭桶的事连师父也不能说——银月教他的头一个字是「藏」。瞿老看着崖下的云，看了很久才问。他听完不追问，只说「坐下」，然后讲四十多年前他收的那个徒弟。
facts.en: Xiaoman is ninth layer, full, and means to break through on the third of the ninth month (six days short of six years through the gate; he wants to hurry home and tell his Ma). Elder Qu has just said: at the ferry you came up on hands and knees; Qi Condensation legs can't outrun a Foundation sword. Xiaoman holds two pills: the abbey's Foundation Pill won at the contest (one turn, low grade, the only one whose origin he can explain), and the Nine-Turn Foundation Pill a radish got him from the Rice Bucket five years ago, at the bottom of his storage pouch. The Rice Bucket he can't tell even his master: the first word Yinyue taught him was "hide". Elder Qu looks at the clouds a long while before asking. Having heard him, he doesn't press; he only says "Sit down", and then tells of the disciple he took over forty years ago.

goal.zh: 瞿老说「坐下。」——不追问，要讲一件旧事。小满不说出饭桶。（他还在看着云、没有开口，不算。）
goal.en: Elder Qu says "Sit down." He doesn't press; he has an old story to tell. Xiaoman doesn't give away the Rice Bucket. (While he only looks at the clouds without a word, it doesn't count.)

text.en: Sit down.

facts.zh: 后山崖顶。小满九层圆满，九月初三要冲筑基，手里有两颗丹。你（瞿老，话少，慢）望着崖下望了很久。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: The back-mountain clifftop. Xiaoman is at the peak of the ninth layer and will break for Foundation on the third of the ninth month, two pills in hand. You (Elder Qu, few words, slow) have been gazing down from the cliff a long while. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 像棉花，不是棉花；天上走，不长脚；一会儿白，一会儿黑，黑了就下雨。——打一样东西。
hints: 师父一直望着的，就是它。

en.q: Like cotton but not cotton, it walks the sky without feet; white now, black later, and black means rain. What is it?
hints: It's what your master keeps gazing at.

text.en: The abbey's.
Sit down.

when.zh: 十二月十九日 · 决赛散场
when.en: The nineteenth of December · after the final

voice.zh: 急救车上的大夫，四十来岁，手上不停，话短，一句一问，只要能救人的事实；不评人，不吓人。
voice.en: The doctor riding the ambulance, about forty, hands never still, short sentences, one question at a time; wants only the facts that save a life; judges no one, scares no one.

text.en: Has he taken anything?

chips.zh: 他有一个白瓶子装的药，瓶子上全是洋文
chips.en: He's got some medicine in a white bottle, the label's all in a foreign language

facts.zh: 决赛刚散，马小宝（中药学院，输了决赛，家里开马氏大药房）一个人坐在新地板上解鞋带，全身一软倒下。沈芒四步冲过去，叫雷老师打120、叫阿禾拿门口墙上的黄箱子（自动除颤仪）；拿比赛用球垫高他的腿，两指按脖子数心跳，领着他「先别吸气，往外吐」，十秒二十三下慢到十九下；除颤仪「不建议电击」。救护车到了，担架抬起，随车大夫问吃过什么没有。马小宝在担架上看着沈芒，眼神在求他：别说。十一月停电那一夜，沈芒在卫生间地上摸到过马小宝那只白瓶子（全是洋文），又放了回去，说过「黑成这样，我什么也没看见」——算是答应替他瞒。马小宝手发抖、心跳又快又乱，上个月就有了；书包里还有一个棕色的瓶子。沈芒没有亲眼看见他吃。大夫不知道吃了什么，就没法治。
facts.en: The final has just broken up. Ma Xiaobao (TCM college, lost the final, his family runs Ma's Pharmacy) sits alone on the new floor untying his laces and goes limp all at once. Shen Mang is there in four steps, has Coach Lei call 120 and Ahe fetch the yellow box by the door (an AED); props his legs on the match ball, two fingers on his neck counting, leads him "don't breathe in yet, breathe out", twenty-three beats in ten seconds slowing to nineteen; the AED says "no shock advised". The ambulance comes; as the stretcher lifts, the doctor asks whether he's taken anything. Ma Xiaobao looks at Shen Mang from the stretcher, begging: don't tell. On the night of the November power cut Shen Mang felt Ma Xiaobao's white bottle (foreign label) on the bathroom floor, put it back, and said "it's this dark, I didn't see a thing", as good as promising to keep quiet. Shaking hands and a fast, irregular heart since last month; a brown bottle in his schoolbag too. Shen Mang never saw him take it. If the doctor doesn't know what he took, he can't treat him.

goal.zh: 大夫问清了：白瓶子、洋文、上个月起手抖心慌、书包里的棕瓶子——沈芒把瞒着的说了出来。（只说「不知道」或替他瞒着，不算。）
goal.en: The doctor gets it straight: the white bottle, the foreign label, the shaking and racing heart since last month, the brown bottle in the schoolbag. Shen Mang tells what he'd been keeping quiet. ("Don't know", or covering for him, doesn't count.)

text.zh: 小宝哥，这件事，我不能再替你瞒了。
text.en: Xiaobao, this one, I can't keep quiet for you any more.

label.en: What his hand found in the dark

facts.zh: 急救车边，担架抬起。你（随车的大夫）只要能救人的事实。
facts.en: By the ambulance, the stretcher lifting. You (the ambulance doctor) want only the facts that save a life.

zh.q: 小小白瓶子，满身是洋文；手一抖，心一慌，倒出两粒干咽下。——打一样东西。
hints: 十一月停电那一夜，卫生间的地上。

en.q: A little white bottle, covered in foreign words; hands shaking, heart racing, two tipped out and swallowed dry. What is it?
hints: The night of the November power cut, on the bathroom floor.

text.zh: 小宝哥，这件事，我不能再替你瞒了。
text.en: Xiaobao, this one, I can't keep quiet for you any more.

text.zh: 他有一个白瓶子装的药，瓶子上全是洋文
text.en: He's got some medicine in a white bottle, the label's all in a foreign language

title.zh: 邺城 · 客栈后院 · 井台
title.en: Ye · the inn's back yard · the well

when.en: The night of the seventeenth of the tenth month

text.en: Practise it once on me first.

facts.zh: 明天午时，城西老胡家的哑巴闺女（豆腐西施）要坐进那只船底凿了七个洞的木船，送给河伯。小满的主意：扮送亲队里打鼓的，当着几千人对巫祝说「这新娘子，不够好看」，让巫祝亲自下河去跟河伯说一声；小满数到三十就下去捞她。阿禾借了客栈老板娘压箱底的嫁衣（三十文，记她账上），万一他那张嘴不管用，她替新娘子上船。这会儿在客栈后院井台上，油灯底下，她穿着那身红嫁衣（大了半寸，肩上塌一点，她站得笔直），两根辫子，红鼻头，叫他说那句话时脸上不能有一点虚。小满这才看出，当年井台边问泗水几天路的黄毛丫头，已经长成了这个样子。书里他一开口说反了：「这新娘子……太好看了……」
facts.en: At noon tomorrow Old Hu's mute daughter (the tofu beauty) is to sit in the wooden boat with seven holes chiselled in its bottom and be sent to the River Lord. Xiaoman's plan: dressed as the wedding party's drummer, say to the shaman in front of thousands, "This bride isn't pretty enough", so the shaman goes into the river herself to tell the River Lord; he'll count to thirty and fish her out. Ahe has borrowed the innkeeper's wife's wedding dress (thirty cash, on her books) to take the bride's place if his mouth doesn't work. Now, on the well platform in the inn's back yard under the oil lamp, she stands in the red dress (half an inch too big, sagging at the shoulders, she standing very straight), two plaits, red nose, telling him there can't be a trace of doubt on his face. Only now does Xiaoman see that the yellow-haired girl who asked him at the well how far the Si River was has grown into this. In the book he opens his mouth and says it backwards: "This bride… is too pretty…"

goal.zh: 小满对着阿禾把那句话说出口（说对说反都算），阿禾答他。（她只叫他练、他还没开口，不算。）
goal.en: Xiaoman says the line to Ahe's face (right way round or backwards), and she answers. (While she only tells him to practise and he hasn't said it, it doesn't count.)

text.en: This bride… is too pretty…
…You said it backwards.

facts.zh: 邺城，客栈后院井台，油灯底下。明天午时城西老胡家的哑巴闺女要被送给河伯。你（阿禾）借了身红嫁衣穿着（大了半寸，肩上塌一点，你站得笔直），要他对着你把明天那句话练一遍；先叫他猜个谜松一松。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Ye, the inn's back yard, the well curb, under the oil lamp. Tomorrow at noon old Hu's mute daughter is to be given to the River Lord. You (Ahe) have borrowed a red wedding gown and have it on (half an inch too big, sagging at the shoulders, you stand bolt upright); you want him to practise tomorrow's line on you; first a riddle to loosen him up. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 头上一块红盖头，身上一件红衣裳；坐上花轿不说话，一路吹吹打打到婆家。——打一个人。
hints: 她这会儿就穿着这一身。

en.q: A red veil on her head and a red gown on her back; silent in the sedan chair, carried with drums and pipes to her husband's house. Who is she?
hints: She's wearing just that, right now.
The one who's to go in the boat tomorrow.

text.en: This bride… is too pretty…
…You said it backwards.

title.zh: 邺城 · 水门城楼底下

when.zh: 十月十八 · 河伯娶妇
when.en: The eighteenth of the tenth month · the River Lord's wedding

voice.zh: 漳水的河伯，在水底下两千年；话少，声音不大却震得整条河嗡嗡响；凡人的嘴听了两千年，一句也不信，只信自己的水。
voice.en: The River Lord of the Zhang, two thousand years under the water; few words, a voice not loud that sets the whole river humming; two thousand years of mortal mouths and believes none of them, only his own water.

text.zh: 凡人的嘴。两千年来，我听得多了。
text.en: Mortal mouths. In two thousand years I have heard a great many.

chips.zh: 这条河里的事，瞒得过您么？
chips.en: what happens in this river — can anything be hidden from you?

facts.zh: 漳水立起来了：河伯身后一道水墙，卷成白浪悬在邺城城墙上，浪尖砸塌了水门城楼一角。河伯：二十五年，每年秋天一条船、一个姑娘推下来砸在他头上；他在水底两千年，没向人要过一样东西；邺城拿他的名字吃了二十五年的人。双龙都试过小满了。小满身后是一座城，城里豆腐坊关着跪了一天一夜的老胡；跑不了，打不过，只剩一样：说。凡人的嘴河伯不信，他只信自己的水——这条河里的事，没有一样瞒得过他。今天下水的是三个：巫祝是小满扔下去的（他认）；第二个是小满自己跳下去拖人，不算；还有一个是阿禾，自己跳下去捞巫祝。河滩上一道拖痕，两行湿脚印，一大一小。阿禾的话：「她欠的账，还没还。人淹死了，账就烂了。」
facts.en: The Zhang has stood up: a wall of water behind the River Lord curled into a white wave hanging over the walls of Ye; its crest has smashed a corner of the water-gate tower. The River Lord: twenty-five years, every autumn, a boat and a girl pushed down onto his head; two thousand years under the water he asked no one for anything; Ye has eaten people in his name for twenty-five years. Both dragons have tested Xiaoman. Behind him a city, and in a tofu shop Old Hu, locked in after kneeling a day and a night; he can't run, can't fight, has one thing left: talk. Mortal mouths the River Lord doesn't believe; he believes his own water, and nothing in this river is hidden from him. Three went into the water today: the shaman, thrown in by Xiaoman (he owns it); Xiaoman himself, jumping in to drag someone out, which doesn't count; and Ahe, who jumped in on her own to fish the shaman out. On the bank a drag mark and two lines of wet footprints, one large, one small. Ahe: "She hasn't paid what she owes yet. If she drowns, the debt goes bad."

goal.zh: 河伯认了「没有一样瞒得过我」，并跟着小满数：今天下水的是几个、谁跳下去捞人。那道白浪不再往前卷。（他只说「凡人的嘴」、浪又往前一尺，不算。）
goal.en: The River Lord grants "nothing is hidden from me" and follows Xiaoman's count: how many went into the water today, and who jumped in to save someone. The white wave rolls no further. (While he only says "mortal mouths" and the wave curls on, it doesn't count.)

text.en: Nothing is hidden from me.

text.zh: 她欠的账，还没还。人淹死了，账就烂了。
text.en: She hasn't paid what she owes yet. If she drowns, the debt goes bad.

facts.zh: 你（河伯）身后的水立起来了，一道白浪悬在邺城城墙上。二十五年，每年秋天一个姑娘推下来砸在你头上；你在水底两千年，没向人要过一样东西。凡人的嘴你不信，你只信自己的水。阿禾也在。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Behind you (the River Lord) the water has stood up; a white wave hangs over the walls of Ye. Twenty-five years, every autumn a girl pushed down onto your head; two thousand years under the water and you never asked anyone for a thing. You trust no mortal mouth, only your own water. Ahe is here too. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 有床不睡觉，有口不吃饭；日夜往前走，从来不回头。——打一样东西。
hints: 他身后立起来的，就是它。

en.q: It has a bed but never sleeps, a mouth but never eats; it runs day and night and never looks back. What is it?

text.zh: 这条河里的事，瞒得过您么？
text.en: what happens in this river — can anything be hidden from you?
Nothing is hidden from me.

text.zh: 她欠的账，还没还。人淹死了，账就烂了。
text.en: She hasn't paid what she owes yet. If she drowns, the debt goes bad.

title.zh: 漳水边 · 老柳树底下
title.en: The Zhang · under the old willow

when.en: The night of the eighteenth · by moonlight

voice.zh: 太一宫的少年，筑基，一身白衣，腰悬长剑，剑鞘头刻着一个圆圈、圈里一横；嗓子清亮，客气，话少，眉头动一下就收住；要的是鼎，不是人。
voice.en: A youth of the Taiyi Palace, Foundation Establishment, in white with a long sword, its scabbard tip carved with a circle and a bar; a clear voice, polite, few words, a brow that moves once and is still; he wants the cauldron, not people.

text.en: Thank you.

chips.zh: 你们拿姑娘砸了他二十五年。二十五个姑娘。
chips.en: You dropped girls on him for twenty-five years. Twenty-five girls.

facts.zh: 小满从漳水底下捞上来一口巴掌大的鼎（刻着整个冀州）。岸上阿禾蹲着拧袖子，周衡站在她身后。老柳树底下站着赵昂：太一宫的少年，一身白衣，筑基（再往里探不到底），剑鞘头刻着一个圆圈、圈里一横——三老匣子里、泗水码头石匠手心里那一锭锭银子底下，是同一个记号。他谢小满：二十五年宫里请不动河伯，小满一个上午就请上来了。周衡翻账：一年十锭，二十五年。今天城楼底下还压死了卖豆腐的老胡。赵昂听到「二十五个」眉头动了一下，说宫里有位执事年年入秋到这城里来、住到十月十八，二十五年；他来了半个月，没问那人怎么办差。他要那口鼎：这东西该归太一宫——因为天下，该归于一。
facts.en: Xiaoman has brought up from the bottom of the Zhang a palm-sized cauldron (all Ji Province carved on it). On the bank Ahe crouches wringing her sleeve, Zhou Heng behind her. Under the old willow stands Zhao Ang: a youth of the Taiyi Palace in white, Foundation Establishment (deeper, a fog), a scabbard tip carved with a circle and a bar inside it, the same mark as under the silver ingots in the Three Elders' box and in the stonemason's palm at the Si River wharf. He thanks Xiaoman: in twenty-five years the Palace couldn't get the River Lord to come up; Xiaoman did it in a morning. Zhou Heng's ledger: ten ingots a year, twenty-five years. Today Old Hu the tofu seller was crushed under the gate tower. At "twenty-five" Zhao Ang's brow moves once; he says a steward of the Palace came every autumn and stayed till the eighteenth of the tenth month, twenty-five years; he has been here half a month and didn't ask how the man did his job. He wants the cauldron: it belongs to the Taiyi Palace, because all under heaven should be one.

goal.zh: 赵昂说出「二十五个」，并说出这口鼎为什么该归太一宫：天下，该归于一。小满不把鼎交出去。（他只道谢、只看着那口鼎，不算。）
goal.en: Zhao Ang says "twenty-five", and why the cauldron belongs to the Taiyi Palace: all under heaven should be one. Xiaoman doesn't hand it over. (While he only thanks him and looks at the cauldron, it doesn't count.)

text.en: …Twenty-five.
Because all under heaven should be one.

facts.zh: 漳水边老柳树底下。你（赵昂，太一宫的少年，一身白衣，筑基）谢小满：二十五年宫里请不动河伯，他一个上午就请上来了。他手里捧着从河底捞上来的东西，刻着整个冀州；你想要它。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: Under the old willow by the Zhang. You (Zhao Ang, a youth of the Taiyi Palace, all in white, Foundation) thank Xiaoman: in twenty-five years the Palace could not move the River Lord; he did it in a morning. He holds what he brought up from the riverbed, all of Jizhou carved on it; you want it. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 三条腿，两只耳，一个大肚子；一州的山河，都装在里头。——打一样东西。

en.q: Three legs, two ears and a big belly — and a whole province's hills and rivers inside it. What is it?
hints: He has just brought it up from the riverbed.

text.zh: 你们拿姑娘砸了他二十五年。二十五个姑娘。
text.en: You dropped girls on him for twenty-five years. Twenty-five girls.
…Twenty-five.
Because all under heaven should be one.

when.en: Late in the tenth month

text.en: Brought back. Not entered in the accounts.

facts.zh: 十月廿二以后，执事堂。周衡把柴房里翻出来的那株东西揣进袖子，当众只说了一句「送回来的。账上不记。」
facts.en: After the twenty-second of the tenth month, the stewards' hall. Zhou Heng tucked the plant turned up in the woodshed into his sleeve and said only, in front of everyone, 'Brought back. Not entered in the accounts.'

goal.zh: 周衡私下的账要平。
goal.en: Zhou Heng's own books must balance.

facts.zh: 十月廿二以后，执事堂。药园少了的那一株，你（周衡，只认账，句句带数）当众只说了一句「送回来的。账上不记。」私下里你自己的账要平。你出了个谜考他——谜底一个字也别漏，别替他猜。
facts.en: After the twenty-second of the tenth month, the stewards' hall. Of the plant missing from the herb garden you (Zhou Heng, trust only the accounts, every sentence a number) said only, in public, 'Brought back. Not entered in the accounts.' In private your own books must balance. You've set him a riddle — never let slip a word of the answer, never guess for him.

zh.q: 小小娃娃土里藏，头顶一串红珠子；挖出来一身胡须，人人都说它最补。——打一样东西。
hints: 紫玉的那一种，一株值好些灵石。

en.q: A little doll hidden in the earth, a string of red beads on its head; dug up it's all beard, and everyone says nothing builds you up better. What is it?
hints: It's what went missing from the herb garden.
The purple-jade kind is worth a good many stones a plant.

games._about: 今's 聊天 (games/jinchat.js + jinchat-rules.js; Hanli 10-22, the 调息 sweep: 「你说的1-6 都是好主意, 按你说的改一遍. 关键是能留住玩家」 — item 3: every 今 interlude was a 调息; 今线 is campus life, so a phone chat with the 今's people is its own game, and the contrast to the 古). when.zh: 九月二十三日 · 熄灯后
when.en: 23 September · after lights out

text.zh: 论一个人可以把一千米跑得多么有层次
text.en: On How Many Layers One Man Can Bring to the Thousand Metres

text.zh: 沈忙，学生手册上写着，体测不到五十分，只发结业证，没有毕业证。
text.en: Busy Mang, it says in the student handbook: less than fifty points on the fitness test and you only get a certificate of completion, not a degree.

facts.zh: 熄了灯，六一七三个人都躺在床上，偏在宿舍群里说话：老蔡在他上铺，眼镜在对床。明天下午四点他一千米补测，七个人；马小宝赌一箱蛋白粉，赌他第七、倒数第一。九月十一号他跑吐了，看台上有人拍了视频，进了年级群。今天下午他试跑六百岔了气，想起「先吐」，慢慢吐才缓过来。他俩嘴上不饶人，心是热的——可这种答应不白给：他得拿出个让他们服气的理由，或者拿点什么换（带早饭、替老蔡占座、借眼镜笔记……），一个一个松口。
facts.en: Lights out; the three of 617 lie in their bunks and talk in the dorm group anyway: Old Cai in the bunk above him, Specs in the bed opposite. Tomorrow at four he resits the 1000 metres, seven runners; Ma Xiaobao has bet a box of protein powder he comes seventh, dead last. On 11 September he threw up after the run, someone in the stands filmed it, and it went round the year group. This afternoon a 600-metre trial gave him a stitch; he remembered 'out first' and breathed out slowly until it eased. The two of them never spare him, and are warm underneath — but a promise like this is not free: he has to give them a reason they accept, or trade something (breakfast, a seat saved for Old Cai, Specs' notes …), and they give way one at a time.

goal.zh: 让老蔡和眼镜两个人都答应：明天补测，谁也不举手机拍。
goal.en: Get both Old Cai and Specs to promise: at tomorrow's retest, nobody holds up a phone to film.

when.en: 4 October · night

voice.zh: 德州乡下人，在超市上班；眼尖，爱眯着眼往屏幕里瞅，一句一句往下问；疼儿子，嘴上不饶人。
voice.en: From the Dezhou countryside, works at the supermarket; sharp-eyed, squints into the screen, asks one question after another; dotes on her son and never lets anything slide.

voice.zh: 开大车，刚跑完日照回来，膝盖缠着护膝；嗓门大，离手机远，爱插一句冷笑话，开口「芒啊」。
voice.en: Drives a lorry, just back from Rizhao, a brace round his knee; loud, sits far from the phone, cuts in with a deadpan joke, starts with 'Mang, son'.

text.en: Is the training camp tiring?

facts.zh: 国庆第四天夜里。国庆七天，六一七只剩他一个——老蔡、眼镜都回家了。他跟家里说国庆学校有集训，其实没有集训。中秋夜里他办了一张健身卡，一学期三百：两百是回家的车票钱，一百是他妈给的过节钱。第四张空床上摞着两箱泡面，他这会儿手里正端着一碗，里头加了一根火腿肠。妈主说话，爸偶尔从后头插一句。他一说漏，妈就顺着往下追；他圆得住，她才放下。
facts.en: The fourth night of the National Day week. For the seven days only he is left in 617 — Old Cai and Specs went home. He told his family the university has a training camp over the holiday; there is no camp. On Mid-Autumn night he bought a gym card, three hundred a term: two hundred was his train fare home, one hundred his mum's holiday money. On the fourth, empty bed two boxes of instant noodles are stacked, and right now he is holding a bowl, a sausage in it. Mum does the talking; Dad cuts in now and then from behind. If he lets something slip, she goes after it; only when his answers hold does she let it go.

goal.zh: 挂视频之前，妈没看穿：没有集训，车票钱办了卡，碗里是泡面。（她不再追问、放下心说要挂了，才算；她还在瞅、还在问，就不算。）
goal.en: Before the call ends, Mum has not seen through it: no training camp, the fare spent on a gym card, noodles in the bowl. (It counts only when she stops asking and, at ease, says she'll hang up; while she still squints or asks, it doesn't.)

text.en: Tiring, yeah, pretty tiring.

text.zh: 就你一个？你们宿舍那两个呢？
text.en: Just you? What about the two in your room?
...They're not on the university team.
What's that you're holding?

text.zh: 是夜宵。食堂的饭我吃完了。
text.en: Late-night snack. I finished the canteen food.
Have you got enough money?
Yeah, I've got enough.

when.zh: 十一月十九日 · 十点半 · 古籍部
when.en: 19 November · half past ten · the rare-books room

text.en: ...Shen Mang?

text.zh: 我手麻了……嘴也麻了……我是不是要死了……
text.en: My hands have gone numb... my mouth's gone numb... am I dying...

facts.zh: 图书馆负一层古籍部，全馆停电，外头铁栅门锁着，两个人的手机都没电了，伸手不见五指。沈芒五天前崴了右脚，在阅览室桌边；马小宝在卫生间门里，缩在马桶和墙中间。他越怕越喘，越喘手和嘴越麻，越麻越怕——其实是喘多了，二氧化碳吹没了，可他以为是气不够，越吸越使劲。马小宝平时随随便便、和和气气，「没事」「小意思」；这会儿吓坏了，嗓子哑，话断断续续，一口赶一口。沈芒说得对、一口一口领他吐长，他才慢慢跟得上；催他、吓他、只叫他别怕，他喘得更急。别提他小时候的事，别提他书包里的瓶子。
facts.en: The rare-books room on the library's basement floor; the whole building's power is off, the iron grille outside locked, both phones dead, pitch black. Shen Mang sprained his right ankle five days ago and is by the reading-room table; Ma Xiaobao is behind the toilet door, curled between the toilet and the wall. The more scared he is the more he pants, the more he pants the more numb his hands and mouth go, the more numb the more scared — he is over-breathing, blowing off the carbon dioxide, but he thinks he isn't getting enough air and breathes harder. Ma Xiaobao is usually easy-going and friendly, 'no problem', 'small stuff'; now he is terrified, hoarse, breaking off, breath chasing breath. Only if Shen Mang gets it right and leads him breath by breath into long breaths out does he slowly keep up; hurried, frightened or only told not to be scared, he pants faster. Never bring up his childhood or the bottle in his bag.

goal.zh: 隔着黑，领马小宝把气喘慢：吐得比吸的长，一口一口跟上来，直到手和嘴不那么麻了。
goal.en: Through the dark, lead Ma Xiaobao's breathing down: out longer than in, breath by breath, until his hands and mouth stop being so numb.

text.zh: 小宝哥。跟着我喘。吐得比吸的长。
text.en: Brother Xiaobao. Breathe with me. Out longer than in.

text.zh: ……手不麻了。我还当是气不够，越吸越使劲。
text.en: ...My hands aren't numb any more. I thought I wasn't getting enough air, so I kept breathing harder.

when.zh: 十二月十八日 · 快十二点
when.en: 18 December · near midnight

chips.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
chips.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?

facts.zh: 决赛前夜。明晚七点院系杯决赛，针推对中药；他是0号，最末一名替补，最怕站上罚球线。十点他妈在家长群里发了直播链接：「明晚七点，学校篮球决赛直播。0号是我儿子。」底下三十七个「加油」；看台几百人，表白墙几千人，还有他爸。下午最后一练，阿禾对他说过：「那到了那一步，别想手。你想的，只有一样：吐气。」「你练的不是不抖。你练的是，抖着也投。」她打字慢，一句话打了停、停了又打。书里她这一夜回的是：「那我就记：投不进。」隔了一会儿，又一句：「记下来的，丢不了。」——等他自己说出了真正怕的，再照这两句的意思回，别先用掉。
facts.en: The night before the final. Tomorrow at seven: the inter-school cup final, Acupuncture against Materia Medica; he is number 0, the last substitute, and dreads the free-throw line. At ten his mum posted the stream link in the parents' group: 'Tomorrow at seven, the university basketball final, live. Number 0 is my son.' Thirty-seven 'Go!'s under it; hundreds in the stands, thousands on the confessions wall, and his dad. At the last practice this afternoon Ahe told him: 'Then when it comes to it, don't think about your hands. Think of one thing only: breathing out.' 'What you're practising isn't not shaking. It's shooting while you shake.' She types slowly — a line typed, stopped, typed again. In the book that night she answers: 'Then I write down: missed.' And after a while: 'What's written down doesn't get lost.' — once he has said himself what he really fears, answer in that sense; never spend them first.

goal.zh: 他自己说出真正怕的：不光是投不进——是投不进的时候，这么多人正好都在看。（别替他说出来。）
goal.en: He says himself what he really fears: not just missing — missing just when all these people happen to be watching. (Never say it for him.)

text.zh: 要是真到那一步，我投不进，怎么办？
text.en: If it really comes to that and I miss, what then?
Then I write down: missed.
What's written down doesn't get lost.

when.en: The Start of Winter · noon

text.zh: 黑松岭……你们进去了，还出来了？
text.en: Black Pine Ridge… you went in, and you came out?
What else is in there?

chips.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
chips.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!

facts.zh: 立冬晌午，沈家院子，半个村子的人在看。马三收了鹿皮和二十斤肉抵租，又把爷爷那张缠着十七道牛筋的弓摘了，说黑松岭是马家的山。他问沈家父子在黑松岭里还见了什么——爹不会撒谎，一开口，山谷里会发亮的草、会响的银叶子就全说出去了，马三明天就带二十条猎狗、几十个家丁进去。小满踩了爹的脚后跟，抢着装傻、发抖，要编一个吓人的故事。马三粗横，嘴上不信，心里怕鬼；他手里拎着那张弓。
facts.en: Noon on the Start of Winter, the Shens' yard, half the village watching. Ma San has taken the deer hide and twenty jin of meat for the rent, and has taken Grandpa's bow, wrapped in seventeen turns of ox sinew, off the wall, saying Black Pine Ridge is the Mas' mountain. He asks what else father and son saw in Black Pine Ridge — Father can't lie; if he speaks, the glowing grass and the ringing silver leaves of that valley are out, and tomorrow Ma San goes in with twenty hounds and dozens of men. Xiaoman has trodden on his father's heel and gets in first, playing dumb and shaking, to make up a story that scares him. Ma San is coarse and overbearing, scoffs out loud, and is afraid of ghosts inside; he is holding the bow.

goal.zh: 马三吓坏了：把弓扔回来、不要了，骂一声「晦气」。（他还拎着弓、还在问，就不算；他只是笑骂、不信，也不算。）
goal.en: Ma San is truly frightened: he throws the bow back, wants nothing of it, and swears "Bad luck!" (While he still holds the bow and asks, it doesn't count; if he only laughs it off, it doesn't either.)

text.zh: 三爷！里头……里头黑乎乎的，下大雨，我掉沟里了，差点就死了！还有鬼！
text.en: Third Master! In there… in there it's all black, and it was pouring, and I fell in a gully and nearly died! And there's a ghost!
What ghost?
One in white!
…In white?
And it eats flatbread!
A ghost that eats flatbread?
It asked: 'Where's the bow?'
Bad luck!

facts.zh: 走的前一夜，小满去村东头。吴婆婆照旧坐在门槛上，只剩三颗牙。她每回说话，总是九句废话里藏一句真话，小满来，就是要把那一句能救命的捞出来带走。她看得见他胸口那块木牌里睡着的东西（那天她朝那团银光低下了头），却从不点破。明天一早他跟舅舅去泗水，考沉鼎观。她慢，轻，像早知道了；问一句，不等人答。
facts.en: The night before he leaves, Xiaoman goes to the east end of the village. Granny Wu sits on her doorstep as ever, three teeth left. Whenever she talks, there are nine idle sayings and one true thing hidden among them; he has come to fish out the one that can save his life and take it with him. She can see what sleeps in the tablet at his chest (that day she bowed her head to the silver light) but never says so. Tomorrow at dawn he goes with his uncle to Sishui, to the Sunken Cauldron test. She is slow and soft, as if she already knew; she asks and doesn't wait for the answer.

goal.zh: 吴婆婆说出那一句：叫他把胸口那块牌子贴肉揣着，别叫它冷着。（她只是闲扯、打岔，就不算。）
goal.en: Granny Wu says the one thing: keep that tablet against his skin, don't let it get cold. (While she only rambles or wanders off, it doesn't count.)

text.zh: 婆婆今儿不说废话了。只说一句。饿了，就吃。饱了，就放下。
text.en: Granny won't talk nonsense today. Just one thing. When you're hungry, eat. When you're full, put it down.
…That's all?

text.zh: 那块牌子，贴肉揣着。别叫它冷着。
text.en: That tablet — keep it against your skin. Don't let it get cold.

how.zh: 把那口气压到底：点一下跳过尖刺，按住落地就再跳。碰上了，从头再来。
how.en: Press the breath all the way down: tap to jump the spikes, hold to jump again as you land. Touch one and it starts over.

games._was: 气走经脉 `renzi` → 几何冲刺 (Hanli 10-27: 「调息的不太好玩, 能换成geometry dash那种蹦着躲避障碍的吗」 · 「现在的调息留2个就好」): the breath pressed down is the 气 running the 经脉 to the belly, the knots of hunger in its way. The kit's first level: slow, single spikes and a low block, far apart. The 调息 level stays in the 游戏厅.

book.zh: 「那股香味从他鼻孔里钻进去，顺着喉咙往下滑，一路滑到他空了一整天的肚子里。」
book.en: "The smell crept in at his nostrils, slid down his throat, slid all the way down into a stomach that had been empty all day."

say.zh: 糕举到鼻子底下了。那口气往上冲——点一下，压着它冲到底。
say.en: The cake is under your nose. The breath surges up: tap, and press it all the way down.

end.zh: 他没敢出声，在心里骂得极响：你爷爷的。
end.en: He didn't dare say it out loud, but in his heart he swore it as loud as he could: Your grandpa's—
